properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Dependency-inventory entry for the Aave core-v3 build tree: evp_bytestokey (OpenSSL legacy single-round MD5 KDF) ships in the hardhat/ethers toolchain via the browserify crypto shim. No first-party call site in the repo; presence is what this inventory records. Changeable here by pruning dev tooling deps.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: secp256k1 — the Ethereum transaction/signature curve — available in the shipped library via @noble/curves. No first-party call site in this repo, but it underpins every ethers/hardhat test signer and the EIP-712 signing helper (helpers/contracts-helpers.ts), and mirrors the on-chain ecrecover verification in the contracts (reported separately).

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Ed25519 (Shor-vulnerable EdDSA, deadline risk class) available in the shipped library via @noble/curves. No first-party call site found in the application code; recorded as shipped capability.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: elliptic's ECDSA (secp256k1/P-256) available in the shipped library; it is the signing engine behind ethereumjs-util 7.0.2, which the EIP-712 test-signing helper helpers/contracts-helpers.ts imports (fromRpcSig/ECDSASignature). Ecosystem: the same ECDSA-on-secp256k1 the contracts verify via ecrecover.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: X25519 key agreement available in the shipped library via tweetnacl. No first-party call site found in the application code; tweetnacl is here for the ethereumjs signature stack, not for key agreement. Recorded as shipped capability of the toolchain.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Keccak-256 is Ethereum's native hash and the backbone of the protocol's EIP-712 typed-data / EIP-2612 permit flow. The TS uses are event-topic and role-ID derivations in tests; the Solidity-side Keccak-256 (EIP-712 domain separators, typehashes, ACL role IDs) was not scanned by the collector and is reported as separate findings. Quantum exposure: Grover preimage only (A- rating is correct). Changeable here only at the Ethereum protocol level — observable, replaceable only ecosystem-wide.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: PBKDF2 ships in the build as the keystore/wallet KDF of the ethers stack (and the browserify crypto shim). No first-party call site and no iteration-count parameters in this repo — the KDF runs inside the toolchain's wallet handling. Recorded as dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: BLAKE3 available in the shipped library via @noble/hashes. No first-party call site found; recorded as shipped capability. Grover-only quantum exposure.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: noble's SHA-3 available in the shipped library. Note: this is the @noble/hashes package's sha3 — a different library from the keccak/@ethersproject/keccak256 entries grouped under ALG-052c24b2 (Ethereum's pre-standard Keccak-256), so both objects stand separately. No first-party call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Hash-library dependency of the ethereumjs stack in this build; provides SHA-2/SHA-3/BLAKE2/BLAKE3/RIPEMD to the toolchain. No first-party call site found in the application code; presence is the recorded fact.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Crypto library present in the shipped toolchain (ethereumjs/ethers stack). Available in the shipped library; no first-party call site found in the application code.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Scrypt KDF available in the shipped toolchain via the ethereumjs wallet stack. No first-party call site found; no cost parameters (N/r/p) visible in this repo. Recorded as dependency inventory.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: ECDSA/ECDH library in the shipped toolchain; the signing engine behind the EIP-712 test helper (eth-sig-util → ethereumjs-util → elliptic). Available in the shipped library; first-party calls go through the wrapper (reported as its own finding), not to elliptic directly.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: hash.js (SHA-2/RIPEMD/keccak wrappers) is elliptic's hashing backend; available in the shipped toolchain. No first-party call site found.

properties.name: pqs:context
properties.value: Browser pbkdf2 shim of the browserify crypto stack under hardhat tooling. Available in the shipped library; no first-party call site found. Related algorithm object ALG-4de3b020 records the same KDF at its lockfile entries.
